description:
Must have : Python AND Django 
  * Strong communication skills
  * Team player
  * Be able to jump into the project immediately without needing to develop skills
  * Web development experience
  * Needs to have direct experience with automated deployment, scrum/agile teams, peer code reviews, test writing, and everything else we would expect from a senior software engineer
  * Be familiar with writing API’s and refactoring codebases
  * Strong knowledge of modern web frameworks and different view types
  * Needs to be able to give in depth detail on experiences
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
